title: VULNOVA evaluation protocol — temporal validation and readiness

approval.note: This draft does not approve itself and does not adopt a design. Approval requires a written owner decision recorded in a dedicated commit.
approval.approval_method: A signed written decision from the project owner, recorded here with approved_by, approved_on, approval_reference and adopted_design, plus a commit message that cites the decision.

definitions.cutoff_T: A decision point at 00:00:00Z on the cutoff date. Only information observable at or before T may be used as a feature.
definitions.risk_set: Records present in the verified inventory at the pinned revision, well-formed, not rejected, published at or before T, and not in the KEV catalog as observed at T.
definitions.event: A distinct CVE that was in the risk set at T and first entered the KEV catalog within the forward window (T, T+180d]. The observation is the first catalog inclusion, not dateAdded.
definitions.label_maturity: T + 180 days (horizon) + 30 days (maturation lag) = T + 210 days. A block may not be used for a later decision before this date, and its labels are only observable if the served source timeline covers it.
definitions.future_information_leakage: Any value, membership fact, label or revision that was not observable at the decision point but is used to describe it.

admission_rules: Three sequential blocks are required: training, validation and test.
Every block must decide only after all earlier blocks' labels matured (cutoff spacing at least 210 days for single-cutoff blocks).
Every block's label maturity must be covered by the served source timeline before the block is used.
Every block must contain at least 30 distinct test events; rows reused across cutoffs are counted once.
Blocks used as evidence must not share events with each other; reuse is reported and never treated as independent evidence.
No censored cutoff count may be used as a gate result; censored counts are lower bounds.
Absence from KEV is not proof of non-exploitation and may not create a negative label.
Missing historical evidence may not be imputed as absence, and no substitute value may be invented.
An unapproved design may not be used, even if technically feasible.
No gate value may be lowered, and no horizon or maturation lag may be shortened.

candidate_designs.title: Earliest three-block design on the monthly grid
candidate_designs.note: Final block labels mature 2026-10-28. Adopting this design requires the project owner's documented protocol approval; it is not adopted here.

candidate_designs.title: Largest label-matured sequential design (two blocks)
candidate_designs.note: Technically feasible and label-matured, but it provides training and test only. It is not a protocol-compliant three-block substitute and is not adopted.

candidate_designs.title: Single final cutoff
candidate_designs.note: A single matured test block; it is not a train/validation/test design.

candidate_designs.title: Rolling origin, one cutoff at a time
candidate_designs.note: Each cutoff is an independent evaluation point, not a sequential design.

evidence_states.CONFIRMED_KEV_INCLUSION: Observed in a readable, removal-aware KEV catalog revision at the observation point.
evidence_states.ABSENT_FROM_KEV: A readable catalog revision did not list the CVE. This is not proof of non-exploitation and may not create a negative label.
evidence_states.MISSING_HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE: No readable catalog revision is available at the observation point. The question is unanswered; this may not be treated as absence.

approval_record_template.approval_scope: explicitly state which design, which constants and whether the confirmatory NO-GO is lifted
